title: Derived unit equation for a normalized open triangle
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring and j₁:X→T₁, j₂:X→T₂ open immersions with j₁ p=j₂. Let δ:(id_X)_* ⋙ j₂! → j₁! ⋙ p_* be any natural transformation. Suppose δ followed by the inclusion into (j₁p)_* equals the inclusion of j₂!(id_X)_* followed by the corresponding compositor. On bounded-below derived étale module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], set g = j₂!((R(id_X)_* ≅ id).inv) followed by rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange(δ). Then η₂ followed by j₂*(g), the derived inverse-image compositor j₂* ≅ p* ⋙ j₁*, and j₁* of the derived p-adjunction counit, is η₁. Here j! and both open adjunctions are the specified [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction], and p_* is [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. No properness, finite coefficients, or invertibility of δ is assumed. The exact composite is in the Lean record.

proof.text: Normalize the identity pushforward using lowerStarId. Naturality of the open inclusion and lowerStarComp_id_left show that the ordinary transformation g=j₂!(lowerStarId.inv) followed by δ satisfies g followed by p_*(j₁!→j₁*) and the direct-image compositor = j₂!→j₂*. Postcompose the claimed ordinary unit identity with j₁^*(j₁!→j₁*) followed by the j₁ direct-image counit. This is an isomorphism, since its composite with the invertible open-extension unit is identity. Naturality of the p-counit and inverse-image compositor, together with conjugateEquiv_counit and conjugateIsoEquiv_upperStarComp, reduce the equation to the normalization of g and unit_map_openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar_app_counit.

Lift the ordinary natural-transformation equation termwise to bounded-below homotopy categories. Define d to be j₂! of lowerStarIdDerivedPlus.inv followed by rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange δ. The identity-direct-image inverse formula and rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_fac_app show d is computed by g followed by the right-derived unit of p_*. Form the composite of derived open unit, pullback of d, derived inverse-image compositor, and pullback of the derived p-counit as a natural transformation. Compare it to the j₁ open unit by Localization.natTrans_ext. On a Qh object postcompose with the exact comparison factors of j₁! and j₁^*. Counit and compositor naturality, derivedPlus_counit_app_fac, and upperStarCompDerivedPlus_hom_app_factorsh rewrite this to Qh of the homotopy unit equation. The exact open-adjunction unit factorization identifies both endpoint units. Only exact comparison isomorphisms are canceled; the right-derived unit is retained in its original direction.

theorem properOpenDerivedUnitNormalization
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {T₁ T₂ X : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : T₁ ⟶ T₂) (j₁ : X ⟶ T₁) (j₂ : X ⟶ T₂)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₁] [IsOpenImmersion j₂] (h : j₁ ≫ p = j₂)
    (δ : lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (𝟙 X) ⋙
        openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₂ ⟶
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁ ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p)
    (hδ : ∀ F, δ.app F ≫ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).map
          ((openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁).app F) ≫
          (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁ p).hom.app F =
        (openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₂).app
            ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (𝟙 X)).obj F) ≫
          (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (𝟙 X) j₂ (j₁ ≫ p)
            (h.trans (Category.id_comp j₂).symm)).hom.app F)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunctionPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₂).unit.app K ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₂).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₂).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
            ((lowerStarIdDerivedPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).inv.app K) ≫
          (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange δ).app K) ≫
      (upperStarCompDerivedPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁ p j₂ h.symm).hom.app
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).obj
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).derivedPlus.counit.app
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)) =
      (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunctionPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁).unit.app K
